articles.title_en: The long-run effects of risk: an equilibrium approach
articles.title_cn: 风险的长期效应：一种均衡方法
articles.abstract_en: Advanced economies tend to have large financial sectors which can be vulnerable to crises. We employ a DSGE model with banks featuring limited liability to investigate how risk shocks in the financial sector affect long-run macroeconomic outcomes. With full deposit insurance, banks expand balance sheets when risk increases, leading to higher investment and output. With no deposit insurance, we observe substantial drops in long-run credit provision, investment, and output. Reducing moral hazard by lowering the fraction of reimbursed deposits in case of bank default increases the probability of bank default in equilibrium. The long-run probability of bank default under a regime with no deposit insurance is more than 50% higher than under a regime with full deposit insurance for high levels of risk. These differences provide a novel argument in favor of deposit insurance. Our welfare analysis finds that increased risk always reduces welfare, except when there is full deposit insurance and deadweight costs from default are small.
articles.abstract_cn: 发达经济体往往拥有庞大的金融部门，这些部门可能容易受到危机的影响。我们采用一个具有银行有限责任的DSGE模型，研究金融部门的风险冲击如何影响长期宏观经济结果。在完全存款保险下，当风险增加时，银行扩张资产负债表，导致投资和产出增加。在没有存款保险的情况下，我们观察到长期信贷供给、投资和产出大幅下降。通过降低银行违约时存款报销比例来减少道德风险，会增加均衡中银行违约的概率。在没有存款保险的制度下，对于高风险水平，银行违约的长期概率比完全存款保险制度下高出超过50%。这些差异为存款保险提供了新的论据。我们的福利分析发现，增加风险总是降低福利，除非存在完全存款保险且违约的沉没成本较小。

articles.title_en: Who should bear the burden of COVID-19 related fiscal pressure? An optimal income taxation perspective
articles.title_cn: 谁应承担COVID-19相关财政压力的负担？最优所得税视角
articles.abstract_en: The COVID-19 pandemic has led to an increase in public debt in most countries, and the Ukraine war is likely to have similar effects. This will increase fiscal pressure in the future. We study how the shape of the optimal nonlinear income tax schedule is affected by this increase. We calibrate the workhorse optimal income tax model to five European countries: France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the UK. Applying an inverse-optimum approach to the pre COVID-19 economies we obtain the Pareto weights implicitly applied by the different countries. We then ask how the schedule of marginal and average tax rates should be optimally adjusted to the increase in fiscal pressure. For all countries, we find that the increase in fiscal pressure leads to a less progressive optimal tax schedule both in terms of marginal and average tax rates.
articles.abstract_cn: COVID-19大流行导致大多数国家公共债务增加，乌克兰战争可能产生类似影响。这将增加未来的财政压力。我们研究最优非线性所得税表形状如何受到这种增加的影响。我们将标准最优所得税模型校准到五个欧洲国家：法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国。对COVID-19前经济体应用逆最优方法，我们获得了各国隐含应用的帕累托权重。然后我们询问边际税率和平均税率表应如何最优调整以应对财政压力的增加。对所有国家，我们发现财政压力的增加导致最优税收表在边际税率和平均税率方面都变得不那么累进。

articles.title_en: Giving to the children or the taxman?
articles.abstract_en: Wealth transfer tax systems based on inheritances and inter vivos gifts, rather than estates, allow donors to shift wealth among potential recipients with the goal of minimizing tax burdens. However, tax minimization often requires the donor to give up control over wealth if the transfers are made as inter vivos. Usually, such behavior is difficult to analyze as many potential heirs and many different tax schedules are involved. In this article, we study a simple setting that allows us to obtain transparent and credible evidence of inheritance tax responses. Swedish heirs could easily lower their inheritance tax bills to zero by giving part of the inheritance to their children. Using detailed administrative data, we show that many heirs tax minimized in a precise fashion. Still, among those inheriting just above the exemption, only about a half avoided the tax. Preferences for holding wealth and information seem to play major roles. Our findings have general policy relevance, because similar (but more complex) tax avoidance strategies can be used to avoid any inheritance tax.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于继承和生前赠与而非遗产的财富转移税制度，允许捐赠者在潜在受赠者之间转移财富，以最小化税收负担。然而，税收最小化通常要求捐赠者在进行生前转移时放弃对财富的控制。通常，由于涉及许多潜在继承人和不同的税率表，这种行为难以分析。在本文中，我们研究了一个简单的设定，使我们能够获得关于遗产税反应的透明且可信的证据。瑞典继承人可以通过将部分遗产赠予子女，轻松将遗产税降至零。利用详细的行政数据，我们表明许多继承人精确地进行了税收最小化。尽管如此，在继承额略高于免税额的人群中，只有约一半避免了税收。持有财富的偏好和信息似乎起着重要作用。我们的发现具有普遍的政策相关性，因为类似的（但更复杂的）避税策略可用于规避任何遗产税。

articles.title_en: Measuring macroeconomic uncertainty: A cross-country analysis
articles.title_cn: 衡量宏观经济不确定性：一项跨国分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper constructs internationally consistent measures of macroeconomic uncertainty. Our econometric framework extracts uncertainty from revisions in data obtained from standardized national accounts. Applying our model to post-WWII real-time data, we estimate macroeconomic uncertainty for 39 countries. The cross-country dimension of our uncertainty data allows us to study the impact of uncertainty shocks under varying degrees of employment protection legislation. Our empirical findings suggest that the effects of uncertainty shocks are stronger and more persistent in countries with low employment protection compared to countries with high employment protection. These empirical findings are in line with a theoretical model under varying firing cost.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了国际一致的宏观经济不确定性度量。我们的计量经济学框架从标准化国民账户数据的修订中提取不确定性。将我们的模型应用于二战后实时数据，我们估算了39个国家的宏观经济不确定性。我们不确定性数据的跨国维度使我们能够研究在不同程度的就业保护立法下不确定性冲击的影响。我们的实证发现表明，与高就业保护国家相比，低就业保护国家的不确定性冲击效应更强且更持久。这些实证发现与不同解雇成本下的理论模型一致。

articles.title_en: Estimating the euro area output gap using multivariate information and addressing the COVID-19 pandemic
articles.title_cn: 利用多元信息估计欧元区产出缺口并应对COVID-19疫情
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the euro area output gap by applying the Beveridge–Nelson decomposition based on a large Bayesian vector autoregression. Our approach incorporates multivariate information through the inclusion of a wide range of variables in the analysis and addresses data issues associated with the COVID-19 pandemic. The estimated output gap lines up well with the CEPR chronology of the business cycle for the euro area and we find that hours worked, more than the unemployment rate, provides the key source of information about labor utilization in the economy, especially in pinning down the depth of the output gap during the COVID-19 recession when the unemployment rate rose only moderately. Our findings confirm that labor market adjustments to the business cycle in the euro area occur more through the intensive, rather than extensive, margin.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过应用基于大型贝叶斯向量自回归的贝弗里奇-纳尔逊分解来估计欧元区产出缺口。我们的方法通过将广泛变量纳入分析来整合多元信息，并处理与COVID-19疫情相关的数据问题。估计的产出缺口与欧元区商业周期的CEPR年表吻合良好，我们发现工作时间而非失业率提供了经济中劳动力利用的关键信息来源，尤其是在COVID-19衰退期间，当时失业率仅温和上升，工作时间在确定产出缺口深度方面尤为重要。我们的研究结果证实，欧元区劳动力市场对商业周期的调整更多通过集约边际而非广延边际发生。

articles.title_en: Discrimination and sorting in the real estate market: Evidence from terrorist attacks and mosques
articles.title_cn: 房地产市场中的歧视与分类：来自恐怖袭击和清真寺的证据
articles.abstract_en: I evaluate the impact of Islamist terrorist attacks, taken as exogenous shocks which may change individual perceptions towards Middle Easterners and Muslims, on the real-estate market. Using detailed property-level transactions data, I find that US property prices immediately near mosques fell by 5% in the two years following 9/11. I find little evidence of changes in the number of transactions, but an increase of up to 30% in the fraction of Middle Eastern and North African households locating near mosques, indicating increased ethnic and religious sorting from 9/11. Additional evidence suggests that price decreases across areas are in line with increased prejudice.
articles.abstract_cn: 我评估了伊斯兰恐怖袭击（被视为可能改变个人对中东人和穆斯林看法的外生冲击）对房地产市场的影响。利用详细的房产层面交易数据，我发现9/11事件后的两年内，紧邻清真寺的美国房产价格下跌了5%。我几乎没有发现交易数量变化的证据，但发现靠近清真寺的中东和北非家庭比例增加了高达30%，这表明9/11事件后种族和宗教分类加剧。额外证据表明，各地区的价格下降与偏见增加相一致。

articles.title_en: The problem of financing global public goods
articles.abstract_en: A longstanding result from decades of research on the provision of global public goods, is that stable coalitions of cooperating countries are small when the benefits to cooperating are large. This “paradox” of cooperation is seemingly overcome in a recent paper “The Strategic Dimension of Financing Global Public Goods”, by Kornek and Edenhofer (2020). The authors propose a global-public goods game in which countries finance a compensation fund that can balance abatement costs among members. The fund is based on financial transfers, and in the often-explored case of linear benefits and quadratic costs, the proposed institution is credited as being able to support a stable grand coalition. However, when looking carefully at the model, the promising result relies on assumptions and features of an international institution that are not credible because they restrict members’ rights to opt out. The institution’s success relies on countries being required to transfer funds in response to below-average abatement levels. In this short paper we show that when countries have the outside option to renege on the terms of the agreement, no money would be transferred and the institution proposed by Kornek and Edenhofer (2020) reverts to the non-cooperative outcome.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于全球公共品供给的几十年研究得出的一个长期结论是，当合作收益较大时，合作国家的稳定联盟规模较小。这一合作的“悖论”似乎在Kornek和Edenhofer（2020）最近发表的论文《全球公共品融资的战略维度》中得到了克服。作者提出了一个全球公共品博弈，其中各国为一个补偿基金提供资金，该基金可以平衡成员国之间的减排成本。该基金基于金融转移，在线性收益和二次成本的常见情形下，所提出的制度被认为能够支持一个稳定的“大联盟”。然而，仔细审视该模型时，这一有前景的结果依赖于一个国际机构的假设和特征，而这些假设和特征并不可信，因为它们限制了成员退出（opt out）的权利。该制度的成功依赖于各国被要求对低于平均减排水平的情况进行资金转移。在本文中，我们表明，当国家拥有违约（renege）协议条款的外部选择时，不会有资金转移，Kornek和Edenhofer（2020）提出的制度将退回到非合作结果。

articles.title_en: Inflation tolerance ranges in the New Keynesian model
articles.title_cn: 新凯恩斯模型中的通胀容忍区间
articles.abstract_en: A number of central banks in advanced countries use ranges, or bands, around their inflation target to formulate their monetary policy strategy. The adoption of such ranges has been proposed by some policymakers in the context of the Fed and the ECB reviews of their strategies. Using a standard New Keynesian macroeconomic model, we analyze the consequences of tolerance range policies, characterized by a stronger reaction of the central bank to inflation when inflation lies outside the range, than when it is close to the target, i.e. the central value of the band. We show that (i) a tolerance band should not be a zone of inaction: the lack of reaction may trigger substantial unwarranted volatility and lead to multiple equilibria; (ii) the trade-off between the reaction needed outside the range versus inside appears unfavorable: a very strong reaction, when inflation is far from the target, is required to compensate for a moderately lower reaction within tolerance band; (iii) these results, obtained within the framework of a stylized model, are robust to many alterations, in particular allowing for the zero lower bound.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多发达国家的中央银行使用围绕其通胀目标的区间或波段来制定货币政策策略。在美联储和欧洲央行对其策略进行审查的背景下，一些政策制定者提出了采用此类区间的建议。我们使用一个标准的新凯恩斯宏观经济模型，分析了容忍区间政策的影响，其特征是当通胀位于区间之外时，中央银行对通胀的反应比通胀接近目标（即波段的中心值）时更为强烈。我们表明：（i）容忍区间不应是一个不作为的区域：缺乏反应可能引发大量不必要的波动并导致多重均衡；（ii）区间外所需反应与区间内反应之间的权衡似乎不利：当通胀远离目标时，需要非常强烈的反应来补偿容忍区间内适度较低的反应；（iii）这些在简化模型框架内获得的结果对许多改动具有稳健性，特别是允许零利率下限的情况。

articles.title_en: Macroeconomic effects of tax rate and base changes: Evidence from fiscal consolidations
articles.title_cn: 税率与税基变动的宏观经济效应：来自财政整顿的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the macroeconomic effects of tax changes during fiscal consolidations. We build a new narrative dataset of tax changes during fiscal consolidation years, containing detailed information on the expected yield, motivation, and announcement and implementation dates of more than 2000 tax measures across 10 OECD countries. Using this data, we then analyze the macroeconomic impact of tax changes, distinguishing between tax rate and tax base changes, and further differentiating between changes in personal income, corporate income, and value added taxes. Our results suggest that base broadening during fiscal consolidations leads to smaller output and employment declines compared to rate hikes, even when distinguishing between tax types.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了财政整顿期间税收变动的宏观经济效应。我们构建了一个新的财政整顿年份税收变动的叙事数据集，包含超过2000项税收措施的预期收益、动机以及公告和实施日期的详细信息，覆盖10个OECD国家。利用这些数据，我们分析了税收变动的宏观经济影响，区分了税率变动和税基变动，并进一步区分了个人所得税、公司所得税和增值税的变动。我们的结果表明，与提高税率相比，财政整顿期间扩大税基导致的产出和就业下降幅度更小，即使在区分税种的情况下也是如此。

articles.title_en: The heterogeneous welfare effects of business cycles
articles.title_cn: 经济周期波动的异质性福利效应
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the welfare effects of business cycle fluctuations from a distributional perspective. To this end, we develop a quantitative heterogeneous-agent model which incorporates market incompleteness and non-convexity into the mapping from the time devoted to work to labor services. In this setup, households can insure against aggregate uncertainty using labor and savings and have substantially different labor supply elasticities. We find that the welfare effects are heterogeneous across households, with wealth-rich households benefiting most from business cycles. Wealth-rich households enjoy business cycles more than wealth-poor households, because they experience less volatile consumption and can enjoy higher average income through reallocating savings intertemporally.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究从分配视角探讨经济周期波动的福利效应。为此，我们构建了一个定量异质性主体模型，该模型将市场不完全性和非凸性纳入从工作时间到劳动服务的映射中。在此设定下，家庭可以通过劳动和储蓄来对冲总体不确定性，并且具有显著不同的劳动供给弹性。我们发现，福利效应在家庭间是异质的，其中富裕家庭从经济周期中获益最多。富裕家庭比贫穷家庭更能享受经济周期，因为它们经历的消费波动较小，并且可以通过跨期重新配置储蓄来享受更高的平均收入。

articles.title_en: Backward versus forward integration of firms in global value chains
articles.title_cn: 全球价值链中企业的后向与前向整合
articles.abstract_en: This paper seeks to understand the forces determining the pattern of asset ownership in global value chains. We augment a standard model of vertical integration rooted in the property-rights theory to account for fixed integration costs and derive four channels of influence for the cross-country and cross-sector pattern of asset ownership: the relative investment intensity of sectors and countries; the relative density of markets; the relative reliance on and importance of supplying and producing country-sectors; and the relative importance of fixed integration costs. We confirm the relevance of these determinants for the observed pattern of asset ownership in a large panel of worldwide directed ownership linkages.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在理解决定全球价值链中资产所有权模式的力量。我们在产权理论的基础上，对标准的纵向整合模型进行扩展，以考虑固定整合成本，并推导出影响资产所有权跨国和跨部门模式的四个渠道：部门和国家的相对投资强度；市场的相对密度；对供应和生产国部门的相对依赖及其重要性；以及固定整合成本的相对重要性。我们通过一个包含全球定向所有权联系的大型面板数据，证实了这些决定因素与观察到的资产所有权模式的相关性。

articles.title_en: Euro area sovereign bond risk premia before and during the Covid-19 pandemic
articles.title_cn: Covid-19大流行之前和期间的欧元区主权债券风险溢价
articles.abstract_en: We provide a novel modeling framework to decompose euro area sovereign bond yields into five distinct components: (i) expected future short-term risk-free rates and a term premium, (ii) a default risk premium, (iii) redenomination risk premium, (iv) liquidity risk premium, and (v) segmentation (convenience) premium. Identification is achieved by considering sovereign yields jointly with other rates, including sovereign credit default swap spreads with and without redenomination as a credit event trigger. We illustrate our model by studying yield components embedded in German, French, Italian, and Spanish sovereign bonds, before and after the onset of the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020, and by examining the impact of European Central Bank (ECB) monetary policy and European Union (EU) fiscal policy announcements in response to the pandemic. We find that all five risk premia became sizable following the onset of the pandemic, and that both monetary and fiscal policy announcements had a pronounced effect on yields, mostly through default, redenomination, and segmentation (convenience) premia.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个新颖的模型框架，将欧元区主权债券收益率分解为五个不同的组成部分：(i) 预期未来短期无风险利率和期限溢价，(ii) 违约风险溢价，(iii) 重新计价风险溢价，(iv) 流动性风险溢价，以及 (v) 分割（便利）溢价。识别是通过结合考虑主权收益率和其他利率来实现的，包括在有或没有重新计价作为信用事件触发因素的情况下的主权信用违约掉期利差。我们通过研究2020新冠病毒19大流行爆发前后德国、法国、意大利和西班牙主权债券中嵌入的收益率组成部分，并研究欧洲央行 (ECB) 货币政策和欧盟 (EU) 财政政策公告针对这一流行病的影响来说明我们的模型。我们发现，大流行爆发后，所有五种风险溢价都变得相当大，而且货币和财政政策公告都对收益率产生了显着影响，主要是通过违约、重新计价和分割（便利）溢价。

articles.title_en: It Pays to be big: Price discrimination in maritime shipping
articles.title_cn: 大者有利：海运中的价格歧视
articles.abstract_en: We explore theoretically and empirically the within-route price discrimination in liner shipping and condition it on the market density. Our simple model with informational frictions predicts carrier price discrimination against smaller importing firms under the condition that the number of available carriers on the route is sufficiently large. Using transaction-level data from over 200 Chilean import port-to-port routes, we confirm our theoretical predictions and demonstrate their robustness and economic significance. Ranked by their annual importing size, importers in the 10th percentile pay 18% higher freight rates than importers in the 90th percentile, but only on routes with more than three carriers. Our results indicate that reducing market power distortion in the upstream sector (transportation) may amplify the informational friction distortion and price discrimination in the downstream sectors (importing industries).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们从理论和实证上探讨了班轮运输中的航线内价格歧视，并将其与市场密度相联系。我们的简单模型包含信息摩擦，预测在航线上的可用承运人数量足够多的情况下，承运人会对较小的进口企业实施价格歧视。利用来自智利超过200个港口到港口航线的交易级数据，我们证实了我们的理论预测，并展示了其稳健性和经济显著性。按年度进口规模排名，第10百分位的进口商支付的运费率比第90百分位的进口商高18%，但仅限于承运人超过三家的航线。我们的结果表明，减少上游部门（运输）的市场力量扭曲可能会放大下游部门（进口行业）的信息摩擦扭曲和价格歧视。
